SELECT
  sumIf(s.SalesAmount, d.IsHoliday = 'TRUE') / nullIf(countIf(DISTINCT d.DateKey, d.IsHoliday = 'TRUE'), 0) AS avg_holiday_sales,
  sumIf(s.SalesAmount, d.IsHoliday = 'FALSE') / nullIf(countIf(DISTINCT d.DateKey, d.IsHoliday = 'FALSE'), 0) AS avg_regular_sales,
  (avg_holiday_sales - avg_regular_sales) / nullIf(avg_regular_sales, 0) * 100 AS pct_difference
FROM retail.FactSales s
INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d ON s.DateKey = d.DateKey
